title: Icerik alanlari navigasyonu
purpose: HomeContentNavScreen shows 4 entry cards for content types: Yolculuklar, Atolyeler, e-Kitaplar, Kocluk Okulu. Single tap navigates to catalog (AC-FR-E2-03-01/02). Locked/restricted content shows paywall (AC-FR-E2-03-03).

loading.description: 2x2 grid of skeleton cards with shimmer. Section title shown immediately.

ready.description: 2x2 grid: each card shows content type icon, label, item count, and lock badge if subscription required. Tap navigates to catalog. AC-FR-E2-03-01/02 satisfied.

empty.description: Not applicable -- content types always present. Falls back to ready state with 0-item badges.

error.description: Grid shows 'Icerik sayilari yuklenemedi' inline note. Cards still tappable for navigation. Retry link per card.

offline.description: Cached content counts shown. Lock badges use last known subscription status. Navigation still works for cached catalogs.
